summary: FS.GG.SDD owns lifecycle artifacts and their CLI/MVU workflows, independently of Governance rule execution. Program dispatch includes catalog inspection/admitted scaffold, project knowledge, and typed-sdd operations as well as ordinary lifecycle commands. Markdown authoring and schema-versioned normalized/readiness artifacts remain distinct; Typed SDD selects a separate canonical representation and package/tool-bound authority manifest. Scaffold invokes external providers and owns its skeleton, provenance and skill mirroring; provider products are externally owned. Generic Quint decoding/replay delegates to FsQuint through a CLR-compatible mapping facade. Protected source selects four coherent SDD 2.3.0 packages; this audit does not establish their current served bytes, installed adoption or runtime outcomes. The older overview was broadly correct but omitted these actual entry points.
title: Typed lifecycle, representations and external providers
